description.en:
Opens an event sound (a jingle or an effect used by a scene, e.g. "evt_050") and returns its handle. The sound is not started: wait with CMND_SND_IS_LOADING, then start it with CMND_SND_PLAY. The name is prepared by the engine before opening (it can contain the <LG> language placeholder, as in the chapter title sounds).
Sound handles are integers. Streams opened with the CMND_SND_OPEN_* commands (BGM, event sounds, voices, Special Move sounds, map ambience) get a handle that refers to a stream channel. CMND_SND_OPEN_SYS_SE returns a packed number that names a sound effect instead.

Handle of the sound; 0 if the name is missing.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: A sound effect during a scene (real usage, from ev42023000.nut)
